method: Every key below was classified only after opening its image with the Read tool (96 of 97; ice-skating has no_image:true and no file resolves to it). Contested plural/gender facts were checked against Duden and de.wiktionary declension tables, cited per row. Guiding test used for LEMMA MISMATCH: is the pictured thing an INSTANCE/portion of what the word names (corn -> an ear of corn: yes, no mismatch), or a DIFFERENT entity (badminton -> a shuttlecock: a shuttlecock is not badminton, it is equipment used in it -> MISMATCH). Where a row is marked countable-thing but carries a LEMMA MISMATCH, hasPlural applies to the CORRECTED lemma (Schach -> Schachfigur -> Schachfiguren). Do NOT pluralise the current sport/activity-name lemma: fix the lemma first.
